identity.kind: IBC tank (intermediate bulk container) for liquid storage

claims.claim: Ibc tank for storage of water or any liquid
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an IBC tank suitable for liquid storage (typical IBC form factor).
Photo 0 does not show enough detail to verify condition (no clear leak/damage test, no close-up of seams/valve).

risks.risk: Missing/defective outlet valve, tap, or cap (cannot confirm from the photo).
risks.proof: Request a clear close-up photo of the outlet valve/tap and the top cap/closure, plus a short video showing the valve opening/closing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a tank with unknown fittings (assume valve/cap may be faulty or missing).

risks.risk: Leak or micro-cracks in the plastic liner (not visible from this angle).
risks.proof: Request a video of a fill-and-hold test (or ask for proof of pressure/leak test) and close-ups of the bottom corners and seams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free (worst case: treat as needing inspection/possible repair).

risks.risk: Condition of the cage (bent frame, rust, impact damage) affecting safety and usability.
risks.proof: Request photos of all sides of the cage, especially corners and base, taken straight-on and close enough to see bends/rust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/used condition with possible frame wear.

risks.risk: Unclear capacity/size (e.g., 1000L vs other) and whether it matches the buyer’s need.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the tank rating plate/label showing capacity (liters) and any certification markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the common 1000L IBC but with capacity verification missing (worst case: treat as standard used IBC without premium).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the outlet valve/tap and any hoses/adapters (if present).
Clear close-up of the top cap/closure and the tank rating/label (capacity in liters).
Video showing the valve opening/closing and a quick check for drips.
Photos of bottom corners and seams; if possible, evidence of leak test or a fill-and-hold video.
response.reason: The photo confirms the item is an IBC tank, but key details that determine value in Rivers (fittings/valve condition, leak-free status, and capacity label) are not verifiable from this single image. Ask for the decisive close-ups/videos before pricing.
